buildCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable flutter-sdk && export PATH="$PATH:`pwd`/flutter-sdk/bin" && flutter config --enable-web && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY --dart-define=RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=$RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
